preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 5 and 200,000.
The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= uj <= n and 1 <= vj <= n and uj != vj for uj, vj in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the cities uj and vj must be distinct and within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xj <= n and 1 <= yj <= n and xj != yj for xj, yj in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the cities xj and yj must be distinct and within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if any(uj == xj and vj == yj for uj, vj, xj, yj in test_cases) else True
postconditions.description: If JH and JY start at the same cities, the output must be 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if any((uj == xj and vj == yj) or (uj == yj and vj == xj) for uj, vj, xj, yj in test_cases) else True
postconditions.description: If JH and JY will never meet, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout == str(time) for time in results)
postconditions.description: The output must be the time in minutes until JH and JY meet, or -1 if they never meet.
